title: shell-init bash, both bodies from one source
objective: `shell-init` gains a bash body, so `eval "$(bin/devbin shell-init bash)"` gives WSL's default shell the same `dvb` that the zsh line gives zsh (D47). Both bodies render from one source, the zsh-only `--autoload` form stays zsh's, and the same arms run under both shells. Criterion AC-3.1.
